name: The specification (tamyīz)
definition: An indefinite noun in naṣb that makes clear what was vague in a thing or a quantity.
body: Taṣabbaba zaydun ʿaraqan: Zayd dripped — with what? With sweat. Ishtaraytu ʿishrīna ghulāman: twenty — of what? Boys. Where the ḥāl explains a state, the tamyīz explains a thing.
Al-Ājurrūmiyya: always indefinite, and only after the sentence is complete.
